name: Kraft-Wrapped Dark Chocolate Bar
description: A rectangular dark chocolate bar wrapped in matte uncoated kraft paper, folded and creased into a simple parcel-style seam at the ends.
materials: matte uncoated kraft paper wrapper with a fibrous, slightly toothy surface; solid dark chocolate bar beneath, its top ridged into even segmented squares
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, wordmark, printing, or embossed lettering anywhere on the kraft paper wrapper; keep the wrapper fully blank and unprinted at every angle.
preservationNotes: Keep the same rectangular bar silhouette and proportions, the same matte kraft paper color and fold/seam pattern, and the same dark chocolate brown tone consistent across all four angles.
